feats.name: Absolution
feats.effect: Spend a Hero Point to remove one ongoing effect with a touch
feats.details: By spending a Hero Point, touch a target to remove one ongoing effect. May not work against effects from sources greater than your power (higher level Exalt, god, etc.) at SM's discretion.

feats.name: Archmage Tradition
feats.effect: Choose: Arcane Mastery or Spellbloom for enhanced magic control
feats.details: Choose one: Arcane Mastery (spend Hero Point to copy a spell on next turn using same result; creatures without Hero Points may use once per scene) or Spellbloom (when you cast a spell, all allies who cast within 5m have TN reduced by 5 until your next turn).

feats.name: Armor of Contempt
feats.effect: Cannot be forced to go against Alignment even if out of Resolve
feats.details: You've cultivated a fine shell of divine insight and hatred. Even if you run out of Resolve, you cannot be forced to go against your Alignment.

feats.name: Armor Proficiency
feats.effect: Use armor type with reduced penalties
feats.details: Light and medium armor have no penalties; heavy, extreme, and power armor reduce static defense penalty by half. Without this feat, apply armor's AP as penalty to static defense. Optional Rule: Heavy -3, extreme -4, power -7.

feats.name: Armor Specialization
feats.effect: Chosen armor type provides +2 armor points
feats.details: Choose a particular category of armor. That armor type provides +2 armor points.

feats.name: Assassin Strike
feats.effect: Move at Half Move rate as Free Action after melee attack
feats.details: Once per turn when you make a melee attack, you may move at Half Move rate as a Free Action. Your opponent does not get a free attack for disengaging.

feats.name: Back Stab
feats.effect: +2k0 to damage rolls when Ganging Up
feats.details: If you are Ganging Up on your opponent, you gain +2k0 to damage rolls.

feats.name: Battle Rage
feats.effect: May make parry actions while using Frenzy
feats.details: While using Frenzy, you may make parry actions.

feats.name: Blademaster
feats.effect: Reroll a missed melee attack once per round
feats.details: You may reroll a missed melee attack once per round.

feats.name: Blind Fighting
feats.effect: No penalties for fighting blind
feats.details: You do not suffer normal penalties for fighting blind (still can't read, etc.).

feats.name: Catfall
feats.effect: Halve falling distance, always land on feet
feats.details: Halve falling distance when calculating damage, always land on your feet.

feats.name: Channel Energy
feats.effect: Touch target to heal or damage using Resource points
feats.details: As a Half Action, touch a target and spend up to your Level in Resource points. For each point spent, heal 1 HP or deal 1 wound.

feats.name: Cleave
feats.effect: Extra melee attack when you kill an enemy
feats.details: Each time you kill an enemy with a melee attack, you may attack another enemy within reach.

feats.name: Combat Insight
feats.effect: Use Intelligence in place of Dexterity for Dodge, Parry, Aim
feats.details: Use Intelligence in place of Dexterity for Dodge, in place of Level on Aim attacks, and in place of Level on Parry and Disarm rolls.

feats.name: Combat Master
feats.effect: Opponents gain no bonuses for outnumbering you
feats.details: Opponents gain no bonuses for outnumbering you in melee, including Gang Up bonuses and talents like Back Stab.

feats.name: Common Sense
feats.effect: SM may ask for Wisdom roll to avoid stupid actions
feats.details: The SM can ask you to make a Wisdom roll (TN 15) to pick up on when you're about to do something stupid.

feats.name: Counter Attack
feats.effect: Attack opponent after successful parry at -2k0
feats.details: When you successfully parry an attack, you may attack that opponent at -2k0.

feats.name: Crack Shot
feats.effect: Ranged attacks deal +2 damage
feats.details: Ranged attacks deal +2 damage.

feats.name: Crushing Blow
feats.effect: Melee attacks deal +2 damage
feats.details: Melee attacks deal +2 damage.

feats.name: Danger Sense
feats.effect: Act normally in surprise rounds
feats.details: You are never surprised. You may act normally during surprise rounds.

feats.name: Deadeye Shot
feats.effect: Only -1k0 for called shots instead of -2k0
feats.details: Take only -1k0 for called shots (instead of -2k0).

feats.name: Death Before Defeat
feats.effect: Spend Hero Point to ignore non-lethal critical hit effects
feats.details: Spend a Hero Point to ignore effects of a single critical hit (unless it would cause death).

feats.name: Decadence
feats.effect: Never affected by drugs or alcohol
feats.details: You are never affected by drugs or alcohol.

feats.name: Defensive Mobility
feats.effect: +5 to static defense against opportunity attacks
feats.details: +5 to static defense against opportunity attacks.

feats.name: Devastating Critical
feats.effect: Deal additional wound on critical damage
feats.details: Whenever you deal critical damage, deal an additional wound.

feats.name: Divine Bond
feats.effect: Summon a holy steed at will
feats.details: Gain a holy steed (warhorse, riding animal, or small vehicle) summoned as a full action. Lasts one day. If destroyed, cannot use for three days.

feats.name: Divine Grace
feats.effect: Use Charisma instead of Willpower to resist effects
feats.details: Use Charisma in place of Willpower when resisting enemy or environmental effects.

feats.name: Divine Ministration
feats.effect: Spend Hero Point to heal 1d5 HP and remove fatigue
feats.details: As a half action, spend a Hero Point to touch a target, remove a fatigue level, and heal 1d5 HP.

feats.name: Double Tap
feats.effect: Make two ranged attacks with Multiple Attacks action
feats.details: Make two ranged attacks with Multiple Attacks action (not with Recharge, clip size 1, or Full Auto only weapons). Can target different opponents.

feats.name: Eidetic Memory
feats.effect: Perfect recall of anything heard or read
feats.details: Perfect recall of anything you've heard or read.

feats.name: Evasion
feats.effect: Move up to Dexterity in meters when dodging
feats.details: When dodging, also move up to Dexterity in meters. No opportunity attack from the dodged enemy (others may still attack).

feats.name: Expanded Knowledge
feats.effect: Gain additional specialty for all Lore skills
feats.details: Gain an additional specialty for all Lore skills.

feats.name: Fan The Hammer
feats.effect: Make additional ranged attacks up to clip size at cumulative -1k0
feats.details: Make any number of additional ranged attacks up to clip size with Multiple Attacks action. Each attack at -1k0 cumulative (3 attacks = -3k0, etc.). Not usable with Recharge or Full Auto only weapons.

feats.name: Far Shot
feats.effect: No penalties for Long Range
feats.details: No penalties for Long Range. Extreme range penalties still apply.

feats.name: Fast Reflexes
feats.effect: Reroll initiative die
feats.details: Reroll initiative die (must take result of reroll).

feats.name: Fearless
feats.effect: Cool: Immune to fear; Angry: Immune to fear and pinning but TN 15 to disengage
feats.details: Choose Cool (immune to all fear effects) or Angry (immune to fear and pinning, but disengaging or backing down requires Willpower vs TN 15).

feats.name: Fleet of Foot
feats.effect: +Dex meters on Full Move; double speed when running (causes Fatigue)
feats.details: +Dexterity meters on Full Move. When running, double movement for one round. Using two turns in a row causes Fatigue (or spend Resource if immune).

feats.name: Foresight
feats.effect: Spend 10 minutes examining problem for free raise on Int Test
feats.details: Spend 10 minutes examining a problem to get a free raise on your next Int Test.

feats.name: Frenzy
feats.effect: +1 Str/Con, -2 Int/Wis, must attack each turn, cannot parry
feats.details: As a Half Action, enter rage: +1 Strength and Constitution, -2 Intelligence and Wisdom until end of combat. Must make melee attack, move closer to enemy, or Full Auto each turn. Cannot parry.

feats.name: Furious Assault
feats.effect: Second attack on successful All Out Attack that deals wound
feats.details: If All Out Attack hits and deals at least one wound, make a second attack with same bonuses and penalties.

feats.name: Good Reputation
feats.effect: +0k1 to Charm/Persuasion/Command with Peer group
feats.details: +0k1 to Charm, Persuasion, and Command with a group you have as a Peer.

feats.name: Greater Spell Focus
feats.effect: Extra raise on successful magic Tests with chosen school
feats.details: Extra raise on successful magic Tests with chosen school (stacks with Spell Focus).

feats.name: Greater Spell Penetration
feats.effect: Tests to resist spells need additional raise
feats.details: Tests to resist your spells need additional raise (stacks with Spell Penetration).

feats.name: Guardian
feats.effect: Use Parry for attacks against targets within melee range
feats.details: Use Parry against attacks made by or against targets within melee range. Failed parries hit you instead.

feats.name: Hard Target
feats.effect: -2k0 to ranged attacks against you while charging/running
feats.details: When charging or running, opponents take -2k0 to ranged attacks against you until your next turn.

feats.name: Hardy
feats.effect: Always counted as Lightly Wounded while recovering
feats.details: Always counted as Lightly Wounded while recovering from injuries.

feats.name: Hatred
feats.effect: +1k0 to melee attacks against chosen group/race
feats.details: +1k0 to melee attacks against chosen group/race (must be aware of their identity).

feats.name: Heightened Senses
feats.effect: +1k1 to Tests using chosen sense
feats.details: +1k1 to Tests using chosen sense. Can reduce environmental penalties but not give attack bonuses.

feats.name: Hip Shooting
feats.effect: Full Move + single Pistol attack as Full Action
feats.details: As a Full Action, take Full Move and make single shot with ranged weapon (no automatic fire).

feats.name: Implement Focus
feats.effect: Reroll one die on Magic Tests when using Implement
feats.details: When using an Implement, reroll one die on Magic Tests.

feats.name: Improved Back Stab
feats.effect: +0k1 to damage rolls when Ganging Up
feats.details: +0k1 to damage rolls when Ganging Up.

feats.name: Improved Feint
feats.effect: Failed Feint still gives target -2k0 to reactions
feats.details: Failed Feint still gives target -2k0 to reactions. Successful Feint allows Sneak Attack/Improved Sneak Attack benefits.

feats.name: Improved Sneak Attack
feats.effect: Ignore armor of unaware targets
feats.details: Ignore armor of unaware targets (they still lose Static Defense if applicable).

feats.name: Improved Weapon Focus
feats.effect: Additional +0k1 to attacks with specific weapon type
feats.details: +0k1 to attacks with specific weapon type (e.g., Heavy Bolter, not Bolt Weapons).
feats.prerequisites: Weapon Focus with same weapon type

feats.name: Improved Weapon Specialization
feats.effect: Additional +0k1 to damage with specific weapon type
feats.details: +0k1 to damage with specific weapon type (e.g., Lasgun, not Las Weapons).
feats.prerequisites: Weapon Specialization with same weapon type

feats.name: Improvisational Magic
feats.effect: Spend Hero Point to cast lower-rank spell from any school
feats.details: Spend a Hero Point to cast one spell from any school at lower rank than your highest.

feats.name: Iron Jaw
feats.effect: Con Test to shrug off stun effect
feats.details: When stunned, make Con Test (TN 10 + 5 × rounds stunned) to shrug it off. Once per stun effect.

feats.name: Jack of All Trades
feats.effect: Use Advanced skills untrained; +1k0 to basic skills with 0 ranks
feats.details: Use Advanced skills untrained. +1k0 to basic skills with 0 ranks.

feats.name: Jaded
feats.effect: No fear tests for normal gore and death
feats.details: No fear tests for normal gore and death (supernatural effects still apply).

feats.name: Lightning Attack
feats.effect: Three melee attacks with Multiple Attacks action
feats.details: Make three melee attacks with Multiple Attacks action (does not stack with Swift Attack).

feats.name: Light Sleeper
feats.effect: Always counted as awake even when asleep
feats.details: Counted as awake even when asleep. Not helpless while resting.

feats.name: Luck
feats.effect: Reroll one die per day
feats.details: Reroll one die per day (any die, including alignment tests).

feats.name: Mental Fortress
feats.effect: Choose what mind readers perceive
feats.details: When someone reads your thoughts, choose what they perceive.

feats.name: Minor Magic
feats.effect: Gain single level in any magic school with no levels
feats.details: Gain single level in any magic school where you have no levels.

feats.name: Obtain Familiar
feats.effect: Get small animal companion
feats.details: Get a small animal companion (rat, toad, raven, simple robot, etc.) that follows orders and carries messages.

feats.name: Peer
feats.effect: +2k0 to Charm/Persuasion/Command with chosen group
feats.details: +2k0 to Charm, Persuasion, and Command with chosen group.

feats.name: Power Attack
feats.effect: Take -Xk0 to attack to gain +Xk0 to damage (X up to Level)
feats.details: Take -Xk0 to melee attack to gain +Xk0 to damage (X up to Level). Applies to all attacks that round; must decide before attacking.

feats.name: Powerful Charge
feats.effect: +1k0 to melee damage on charge
feats.details: +1k0 to melee damage on a charge.

feats.name: Pure Faith
feats.effect: +2 to all alignment tests
feats.details: +2 to all alignment tests.

feats.name: Purge The Unclean
feats.effect: Spend Hero Point to repel spiritual enemies of your God
feats.details: Spend Hero Point and make opposed Willpower test against spiritual enemy of your deity. Success repels target 2×Willpower meters for 1d10 rounds.

feats.name: Quick Draw
feats.effect: Ready weapon as free action
feats.details: Ready weapon as free action.

feats.name: Sharpshooter
feats.effect: No penalty for Called Shot
feats.details: No penalty for Called Shot.

feats.name: Skill Focus
feats.effect: Gain additional skill specialty
feats.details: Gain additional skill specialty (doesn't require 4 ranks).

feats.name: Sneak Attack
feats.effect: Halve armor of unaware targets
feats.details: Halve armor of unaware targets (round up).

feats.name: Sound Constitution
feats.effect: Gain 1 additional Hit Point
feats.details: Gain 1 additional Hit Point.

feats.name: Speak Language
feats.effect: Learn one additional language
feats.details: Learn one additional language.

feats.name: Spell Book
feats.effect: Learn one additional spell from chosen school at owned rank
feats.details: Choose a magic school. Learn one additional spell at a rank you possess.
feats.prerequisites: At least 1 rank in chosen school

feats.name: Spell Focus
feats.effect: Extra raise on successful magic Tests with chosen school
feats.details: Extra raise on successful magic Tests with chosen school (stacks with Greater Spell Focus).

feats.name: Spell Mastery
feats.effect: Reroll failed Tests for chosen spell (rank 3 or lower)
feats.details: Choose a spell of rank 3 or lower. Reroll failed Tests to cast that spell.

feats.name: Spell Might
feats.effect: Take -2k0 to Magic Roll to add 10 to result
feats.details: Take -2k0 to Magic Roll to add 10 to final result.

feats.name: Spell Penetration
feats.effect: Tests to resist spells need extra raise
feats.details: Tests to resist your spells need extra raise.

feats.name: Spell Specialization
feats.effect: Reroll failed magic test from chosen school once per scene
feats.details: Choose a magic school. Once per scene, reroll failed magic test from that school.

feats.name: Step Aside
feats.effect: Additional reaction for Dodge only
feats.details: Gain additional reaction per round for Dodge only.

feats.name: Strong Minded
feats.effect: Reroll failed Willpower Test to resist magic once per scene
feats.details: Reroll one failed Willpower Test to resist magic per scene.

feats.name: Swift Attack
feats.effect: Two melee attacks with Multiple Attacks action
feats.details: Make two melee attacks with Multiple Attacks action (does not stack with Lightning Attack).

feats.name: Tested
feats.effect: Count as Sanctioned Sorcerer
feats.details: Count as Sanctioned Sorcerer when rolling magic Tests.

feats.name: Touch Spell Specialization
feats.effect: +2k0 to hit with attack spells
feats.details: +2k0 to hit with spells requiring an attack roll.

feats.name: True Grit
feats.effect: Halve critical damage taken
feats.details: Halve critical damage suffered (round up).

feats.name: Two Weapon Fighting
feats.effect: Reduced penalties for dual wielding
feats.details: Reduced penalties for fighting with two weapons.

feats.name: Unremarkable
feats.effect: -2k0 to attempts to identify or describe you
feats.details: Attempts to identify or describe you are at -2k0 (partly supernatural).

feats.name: Virgil's Guidance
feats.effect: Buy Devotion at half cost
feats.details: Buy Devotion at half normal cost.

feats.name: Wall of Steel
feats.effect: Additional reaction for Parry only
feats.details: Gain additional reaction per round for Parry only.

feats.name: Weapon Focus
feats.effect: +2k0 to attacks with specific weapon type
feats.details: +2k0 to attacks with specific weapon type (e.g., Shotgun, not Ordinary Weapons).

feats.name: Weapon Proficiency
feats.effect: Use weapon category with no penalties
feats.details: Gain rolled dice equal to Level on attacks with proficient weapons.

feats.name: Weapon Specialization
feats.effect: +2k0 to damage with specific weapon type
feats.details: +2k0 to damage with specific weapon type (e.g., Needle Gun, not Exotic Weapons).
feats.prerequisites: Weapon Focus with same weapon type

feats.name: Wizard Tradition
feats.effect: Choose special magic tradition effect
feats.details: Choose one tradition effect (cannot take same option twice).

subOptions.Iron Sigil: Abjuration spells grant Aura equal to 5 + Abjuration rank until next turn

subOptions.Emerald Frost: Evocation spells ignore Aura equal to Evocation ranks
subOptions.Speed Dial: After Conjuration spell, next Full Action Conjuration becomes Half Action
subOptions.Chill of the Grave: Necromancy spells grant next Necromancy caster free raise and +5 on Perils

feats.name: Terminator Honors
feats.effect: Gain Armor Specialization; spend Hero Point to negate damage equal to Size + Level
feats.details: Gain Armor Specialization feat. May spend Hero Point to negate damage equal to Size + Level.

feats.name: Celestial Wrath
feats.effect: Once per scene, add Charisma as rolled dice on damage roll
feats.details: Once per scene, add Charisma as rolled dice on a damage roll.

feats.name: Dark Cruelty
feats.effect: +1k1 to Intimidation and Charm tests
feats.details: +1k1 to Intimidation and Charm tests.

feats.name: Warp Fire
feats.effect: Use Warp Miasma to outline target; +2k0 to hit for scene
feats.details: Use Warp Miasma to outline a target within 30m. Attacks against that target are +2k0 to hit for the scene.

feats.name: Dragonborn Frenzy
feats.effect: While critical damaged, attacks deal extra damage equal to total critical damage
feats.details: While you have at least 1 critical damage, attacks deal extra damage equal to total critical damage taken.

feats.name: Dragon Sight
feats.effect: Reroll one failed Perception test per scene; darkvision
feats.details: Reroll one failed Perception test per scene. Can see in the dark.

feats.name: Elven Precision
feats.effect: +2k0 to Elven Accuracy rerolls for Weaponry/Ballistics
feats.details: +2k0 to Elven Accuracy rerolls of Weaponry or Ballistics tests.

feats.name: Light Step
feats.effect: +2k0 to all Acrobatics and Stealth rolls
feats.details: +2k0 to all Acrobatics and Stealth rolls.

feats.name: Guess Destination
feats.effect: Warp Step doesn't require line of sight
feats.details: Warp Step doesn't require line of sight. Shunted to nearest safe spot if target is blocked.

feats.name: Extra Warp
feats.effect: Warp Step goes twice as far
feats.details: Warp Step goes twice as far.

feats.name: Tinker
feats.effect: Sacrifice item to create lower Rarity item at one less quality
feats.details: Sacrifice Average+ quality item to create lower Rarity item at one less quality. Takes at least one hour.

feats.name: Eureka!
feats.effect: Once per scene, Crafts test in place of any other skill
feats.details: Once per scene, make Crafts test in place of any other Test.

feats.name: Second Chance
feats.effect: Once per scene, force opponent to reroll against you
feats.details: Once per scene, force opponent to reroll one roll against you.

feats.name: Halfling Agility
feats.effect: +4 bonus to Static Defense
feats.details: +4 bonus to Static Defense.

feats.name: Able Learner
feats.effect: Always buy skills and feats as if in Free Study
feats.details: Always buy skills and feats as if in Free Study.

feats.name: Human Perseverance
feats.effect: Once per round, +1k0 to an opposed roll
feats.details: Once per round, +1k0 to an opposed roll.

feats.name: Mobbing Up
feats.effect: On failed Fear test, retreat toward ally instead
feats.details: On failed Fear test, retreat toward an ally instead of normal consequences. Stop fleeing when adjacent.

feats.name: I'm Da Boss!
feats.effect: Add Size as bonus to Command, Persuasion, Intimidate
feats.details: Add Size as bonus to Command, Persuasion, and Intimidate tests.

feats.name: Squat Armor Proficiency
feats.effect: Halve all Static Defense penalties for armor
feats.details: Halve all Static Defense penalties for armor.

feats.name: Squat Stability
feats.effect: May choose not to be moved or knocked prone
feats.details: May choose not to be moved or knocked prone by enemy effects.

feats.name: Farsighted
feats.effect: +3 Resolve and +5 to Mental Defense
feats.details: +3 Resolve and +5 to Mental Defense.

feats.name: Move And Shoot
feats.effect: When attacking ranged and moving, Static Defense +5
feats.details: When attacking with ranged weapon and moving same turn, Static Defense increases by 5.

feats.name: Mutation
feats.effect: Natural weapon: 2k2 I or R, Melee, Brawling
feats.details: Natural weapon: 2k2 I or R, Melee, Brawling. Proficient with natural weapons.

feats.name: Outsider
feats.effect: First critical damage in scene reduced to 1 point
feats.details: First time you would suffer critical damage in a scene, take only 1 point instead (negated if would only take 1).

feats.name: Made of Mettle
feats.effect: +1 to your lowest characteristic
feats.details: +1 to your lowest characteristic.

feats.name: Recluse
feats.effect: Immune to poisons; toxins you craft have +5 TN
feats.details: Immune to all poisons and Toxic weapon effect. Toxins you craft have +5 TN to resist.

feats.name: Elder Wyrm's Fire
feats.effect: Breath and natural weapons deal +1k1 damage, +2 Pen, X damage
feats.details: Breath weapons and natural weapons deal +1k1 damage and +2 Pen, damage becomes X.

feats.name: Matron

feats.details: -1 Fellowship, -1 Dexterity, +1 Strength. Lose Pheromones, gain +2 Size, Armor Plating (4), +2k0 Brawling damage.

feats.effect: No food if 2+ hours sunlight; heal 1 HP/hour in sun
feats.details: No food needed if 2+ hours in sunlight. Heal 1 HP per hour in direct sunlight. Vampire Dryads lose Sunlight Weakness instead.

feats.name: Treestrider

feats.details: Once per scene, enter one large living plant and exit another within 1km/Level. Additional use at Levels 3 and 5.

feats.name: Ancestral Recall

feats.details: +1k0 to all Focus Power tests and +10 on Warp Phenomena rolls.

feats.name: Precise Technique

feats.details: Use Elven Accuracy reroll with any Test once per Level per session.

feats.details: Serve as Navigator without Divination magic. Journey counts as one step lower on difficulty table.

feats.name: Escape Artist
feats.effect: Roll twice vs Immobilization; resist even without roll
feats.details: Roll twice vs Immobilization, take better. If no roll allowed, roll Level + Dexterity to resist.

feats.name: Mixed Heritage

feats.details: Choose another race. May take racial feats for that race (if they reference a racial ability you lack, cannot take).

feats.details: +5 Maneuver when serving as Helmsman or piloting any vehicle.

feats.name: Developed Wings
feats.effect: Wing-Aided Movement upgrades to Flyer
feats.details: Wing-Aided Movement upgrades to Flyer at normal Speed.

feats.name: Teacher

feats.details: Once per session per skill, Aid Another anyone you can communicate with; they use one of your Specialties.

feats.details: Gain Peer (Kobolds). Force kobold encounters to begin with social combat. Gain Paranoia feat.

feats.details: Max TN for finding items increased by 5. Reduce Wealth Test TN by 5 when buying from kobolds.

feats.name: Experienced Miner

feats.details: +2k1 to tests involving underground/mining (spelunking, secret doors, stone traps, etc.).

feats.details: Gain free Traps Specialties in Crafts, Perception, Scrutiny, and Tech-Use.

feats.details: When ganging up, you and allies get additional +1k0 to hit and damage with melee attacks.

feats.details: Use Constitution instead of Dexterity for Static Defense.

feats.details: Increase Focus Power TN by 10 to remove Verbal, Somatic, Material keywords and add Subtle.

feats.details: Produce light at will (lantern-level, variable color). Gain Luminen Blast feat.

feats.details: Natural weapon: 1k1 R, Pen 4, Brawling, Toxic, Razor-Sharp.

feats.details: Gain Jumping specialties in Acrobatics and Athletics. Each raise on jump tests counts as two.

feats.details: +2 dots to lowest characteristic, -1 dot to another characteristic.

feats.details: +1k1 damage to claw/bite in Warform. Cannot distinguish friend from foe without Willpower Test (TN 20) each round. Regain 1 Rage per kill in Warform.

feats.name: Get of Fenris
feats.effect: Spend Rage for +1 Str and combat skills; regain on defeat
feats.details: Spend 1 Rage: +1 Strength, Acrobatics, Athletics, Brawling, Weaponry until end of combat/scene. Regain 1 Rage per significant opponent defeated in Warform.

feats.name: Iron Masters
feats.effect: Free Study; +1 Tech-Use/Craft/Politics; Rage on tech destruction
feats.details: Always use Free Study. +1 dot in Tech-Use, Craft, or Politics (max 5). Gain 1 Rage when rare/expensive technology destroyed.

feats.name: Red Talons
feats.effect: -2k0 vs humanoids; social with animals; understand animal speech
feats.details: -2k0 to social rolls vs humanoids. Use social skills on animals in wolf form. Understand animal speech always. Regain 1 Rage per hour in wolf form.

feats.name: Silent Striders
feats.effect: 1 rank Transmutation; +1k1 Focus Power; Rage on Perils
feats.details: Gain 1 rank Transmutation. Purchase as any class. +1k1 on Transmutation Focus Power tests. Regain 1 Rage first time per round rolling Perils of the Warp.

feats.name: Adamic Dragon
feats.effect: Replace Blood Quickening with Metal/Void/Heart/Warp
feats.details: Replace normal Blood Quickening with Metal (+1 Resilience, armor, Razor Sharp claws), Void (+1 Composure, vacuum survival, Proven claws), Heart (+1 Fellowship, social die manipulation, Power Field claws), or Warp (+1 Willpower, Evocation, Orgone Array claws).

feats.details: Claws, natural weapons, breath deal +1k1 damage, +2 Pen, X damage type.
